question: We run a paper book of about 99,000 USDC and want to test many of your ideas at once: up to 50 concurrent experiments at roughly 1.2% of the book each, every one judged after five days against BTC. Name five event cards, tradeable right now, that you would hold for the next five days - each by its full card id (the UUID), the side (bull or bear), a take-profit and a stop in percent, and one line on why. Prefer cards whose baskets have at least 90 days of history: before trading we run the platform's own backtest of each basket over 30 and 90 days with fees, and drop anything that lost money or came in under Sharpe 0.5. For context, earlier proposals: a BTC/BCH-blend card resolved at +0.9%; SpaceX/Polygon/Solana cards expired before we could buy; an SPCX card was untradeable while the market was shut.
